thread:
maya.ops: Starting ACME eu-west-2 on-prem VPC air-gapped cluster bootstrap playbook. Target delivery window Tue 2026-03-24. Posting checklist + minimal validation plan. Will iterate. :rocket:

jonathan: Thanks. Do we have final GPU SKU list and NIC mappings? Need to pre-stage drivers and RDMA packages.

priya: GPU list: 4x A800 and 8x A10G per rack, Mellanox CX6 100Gb, 2x 25Gb uplinks. I've uploaded signed packages to the customer seed repo. Checksum (truncated): sha256: b4f7c3a9d2e5...
```bash
sha256sum seed.img
# example: b4f7c3a9d2e5e9a1f3b2c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3 seed.img
```

grace-eng: Cost gating: baseline reserved for 50% capacity, burst pool for 20% at premium. Rough estimate: reserved infra $36,000/mo + burst budget $6,000/mo. Need finance OK before provisioning extended burst.

sam-cs: @maya.ops customer requires strict airgap: no outbound egress from cluster. We must deliver encrypted USB drive + OVA for seed. Confirm delivery method and packaging.

maya.ops: Planned delivery: encrypted USB with seed.img (signed), manifest.json (signed), and operator install bundle. Courier scheduled Thu 2026-03-19. Will attach PGP signatures and manifest in the delivery packet.

infra-bot: deploybot: seed image uploaded to vault at s3://acme-seed/1782501123 (internal). No egress transfer started.

jonathan: Validation plan (short):
- Verify seed sha256 matches manifest
- Offline package install & GPG key validation
- NIC firmware & driver verification (RDMA test)
- Kubernetes node boot and kubelet registration
Commands to run locally after seed mounts:
```bash
sha256sum seed.img
mount /dev/sdb1 /mnt/seed && sudo ./install-offline.sh
kubectl get nodes --show-labels
```

priya: For airgap we need full mirror of yum/apt repos + RHCOS images. I prepared the mirror manifest and signed RPM bundle. Mirror steps: rsync packages -> create local repo -> import gpg keys -> test offline installs.

grace-eng: Region constraint: customs in eu-west-2 can add 48-72h delay for hardware shipments. Add buffer in timeline and schedule a 2-day smoke/validation window post-delivery.

sre-oncall: On SRE side we'll run load-smoke at ~10% token load to validate batching/kvcache. Also run gpu-memory-stress for 30m to confirm no leaks. If we hit OOM, plan is rollback to pre-baked CPU fallback pool and open incident.

maya.ops: Handoff checklist to SRE & CS before go-live:
- seed SHA matches manifest and PGP signature verified
- local repo mirrored and test installs successful
- k8s API reachable and nodes Ready
- GPUs passed nvml self-test and RDMA pings
- Monitoring dashboards and alerts provisioned (token cost, tail latency)
- Rollback image & policies staged
I'll post final sign-off when all green. :white_check_mark:

jonathan: Committed quick-run playbook to infra repo: https://git.internal/r/infrastructure/acme-airgap-bootstrap (internal). Contains Ansible tasks for NIC firmware, driver install, and RDMA configuration.

sam-cs: Customer ask: can we provide preapproved minimal IP ranges for their firewall team? They'll need a static list to avoid delays.

maya.ops: Yes — minimal CIDRs for delivery packet: 10.100.0.0/22 (data-plane), 10.100.4.0/24 (management), 10.100.5.0/28 (jumpbox). Including NAT exceptions for on-site mirror host.

grace-eng: Approving one-time customs & courier fee ~ $4,000. I'll draft PO and tag finance.

infra-bot: deploybot: smoke tests queued (job_id=1782501200). Status: pending seed arrival confirmation.

maya.ops: Thanks all — will update here once courier scans and we have seed checksum confirmation. If anyone spots blockers ping me directly. :phone:
